title: Lady appears on Easter 2012 with wind and translucent cow

tellings.quote: She came at me at night out of the darkness as a wind the wind hit me and as I'm going backwards to the ground I see a translucent cow run over top of me

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he attracts UFOs, says that on Easter 2012 a figure he calls the Lady came at him at night near his home, out of the darkness, as a wind. He says the wind hit him, and as he fell backward to the ground he saw a see-through cow run right over him.
